title.en: An Act Reorganizing the Representative Districts of the Province of Albay and Creating a Fourth District Comprising the Seven Municipalities in the Island of Catanduanes.

text.en:
The Province of Albay is hereby divided into four representative districts, each district to be
composed as follows: to the First District shall belong the municipalities of Bacacay, Malilipot, Tabaco,
Malinao, Tiwi, and Libog; the Second District shall be composed of the municipalities of Camalig, Daraga,
Legaspi, Manito, and Rapu-rapu; the Third District shall be composed of the municipalities of Guinobatan,
Ligao, Oas, Polangui, Libon, and Jovellar; and to the Fourth District shall belong the municipalities of Virac,
Bato, Baras, Viga, Panganiban, Panpan, and Calolbon.
All acts and regulations, or parts thereof, inconsistent with the provision of this Act are hereby

This Act shall take effect on June first, nineteen hundred and thirty-one.
Approved, December 5, 1929.
